vars.coverTitle: Keep your crew busy without the phone chase
vars.coverSub: A proven landscaping marketing process built to keep your pipeline full and your people busy.
vars.whoTitle: Design-build, maintenance, hardscape and commercial crews
vars.whoIntro: Four business shapes hide under landscaping company. Each one worries about the same thing in a different order: keeping the pipeline full without babysitting the phone.
whoBullets: Design-build firms: patios and full overhauls, selling on trust and portfolio over weeks or months.
Maintenance and lawn care companies: living on route density and retention, not one-off wins.
Hardscape specialists: selling to homeowners and referral partners at the same time.
Commercial grounds crews: selling to property managers on an RFP-driven renewal clock.
All four want the same thing: proof the work is worth calling back about.
vars.brokenTitle: Here's where landscaping marketing usually breaks

brokenItems.title: Google Business Profile
brokenItems.body: Thin or unclaimed in spirit: wrong hours, no recent photos, no replies.

brokenItems.title: The website
brokenItems.body: A logo and a form nobody checks. No proof above the fold.

brokenItems.title: Review engine
brokenItems.body: Great work, zero systematic ask while the yard still looks amazing.

brokenItems.title: Photo proof
brokenItems.body: Before/afters live on a phone and never reach the site or GBP.

brokenItems.title: Quoting and follow-up
brokenItems.body: No callback for two days, the homeowner already booked someone else.

brokenItems.title: Measurement
brokenItems.body: The owner can't say which channel brought which job.

vars.journeyTitle: How a homeowner actually finds you

journeySteps.title: Worry
journeySteps.body: A dead lawn, a bad view, at 9pm

vars.journeyTakeaway: 81% of homeowners research online before hiring a landscaping company (BigOrange).

playItems.title: Claim the GBP
playItems.body: Complete categories, fresh photos, correct seasonal hours.

playItems.title: A site that converts
playItems.body: Proof above the fold and one obvious next step.

playItems.title: Same-night review ask
playItems.body: Text the homeowner while the yard still looks amazing.

playItems.title: A photo pipeline
playItems.body: Before/afters built into the job checklist, not a phone gallery.

playItems.title: Faster follow-up
playItems.body: Quotes answered before the homeowner books someone else.

playItems.title: Source tracking
playItems.body: Ad and SEO spend tied to jobs actually closed.

vars.proofTakeaway: BigOrange's own claimed figures, cited with source and date, not independently re-verified this pass.
vars.plan1: Audit the Google Business Profile, site and review flow; confirm the season you're in.
vars.plan2: Fix GBP categories, hours and photos; rebuild the site to answer, not just look nice.
vars.plan3: Launch a same-night review ask and a photo pipeline built into the job checklist.
vars.plan4: Review estimate-to-close numbers by source and decide what scales into next season.
vars.investmentTitle: A bounded first engagement, then a scoped plan
vars.investmentIntro: No public pricing page exists on bigorange.marketing (checked 2026-09-02). Pricing is shared in the proposal, not guessed at here.
investmentBullets: First engagement is scoped and bounded, not an open-ended retainer.
Pricing is shared in the proposal once we know your season and current setup.
You approve every job photo and homeowner story before it goes public.
We propose the next scope only after the first one earns it.
vars.closeBody: One working session to map the plan around your actual season, timeline and crew capacity.

proof.notes: Sources: BigOrange landscaping hub page, bigorange.marketing/landscaping-marketing-services/, fetched 2026-09-02 (81% research, 3x leads claims). BrightLocal Local Consumer Review Survey 2026, brightlocal.com, fetched 2026-09-02 (97% read reviews).
